lessons.pakistani-english: ur-only lesson (profile ur.md §8 'add' / §4.11 / §9): Pakistani English usages that are fine at home and puzzle listeners abroad (out of station, cousin-brother, pass out, batchmate, shopper, copy, petrol pump, the light has gone, papers / numbers, timings, thrice, Where are you put up?, prepone, expired, I am elder to you), forms that are wrong or misleading in any variety (open / close the light, drink a cigarette, same to same, too much difficult, my head is paining, Myself Ali, isn't it? after every sentence) and Urdu calques (eat medicine, give an exam, good name, real brother); replaces the scaffold's Korean-only lesson konglish; placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck 22 «پاکستانی انگریزی: یہاں اور باہر»; no ko-en counterpart (mirrors hi indian-english, zh chinglish)
lessons.stative-since: ur-only lesson (profile ur.md §8 add, §4.2): states vs actions with the continuous (I am knowing ✗, She is having a car ✗), Urdu سے → since / for / from, and سے + رہا ہے → Present Perfect (states) or Present Perfect Continuous (actions), How long…? for کب سے. The most Urdu-specific grammar zone (Groningen handout on Pakistani English; eWAVE 89; the Hindi evidence cited in hi.md); ko-en has no such lesson. Same id and same English side (checks, practice o / a / x, fill q) as hi-en's stative-since; Urdu prompts and why lines written fresh; body rows carry IPA. Practice meets the article-plural standing rule. Placed after perfect-2 (profile.json lessonOrder.after), deck «اپنا تعارف» (deck 2, the deck of perfect-2).
